---
description: Prepare a complete PR description and changelog entry from verified changes.
mode: agent
---

Use the actual diff, `/docs/verification.md`, and `/docs/code-review.md` to
prepare a PR description with all five sections: Summary (2-3 sentences),
Changes Made (bullets), Test Evidence (actual output or CI link), Known
Limitations, and a Reviewer Checklist. Add an appropriate entry to
`CHANGELOG.md`. Never invent test evidence or claim a PR was created unless it
was successfully created.
